facts.fact: AICCRA reports that IRRI, AfricaRice and Sarmap have piloted a remote-sensing digital rice production monitoring platform in Mali since 2022 (Segou/Mopti and Sikasso Circle), with a 2024-2025 phase planned to scale it nationwide.
facts.system: Satellite-based digital platform for rice production and climate impact monitoring
